Subject: Final go/no-go readout — MAP completion, e-sign path & Day 1 slots

Hi Sophie — quick readout from our MAP check this afternoon and next steps to close out the evaluation and lock a Day 1 slot. TL;DR: engineering evals + SOC2 evidence complete, SOW redline nearly done, procurement window and signature order are the remaining gating items.

Summary of outstanding MAP items (all in MAP_v3.xlsx):
- Feature acceptance: pass for vector search + reranking (engineering sign-off done)
- Performance SLA: verified on dedicated pool, latency targets met in staging
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence and encryption notes attached (SOC2_summary.pdf)
- SOW: legal proposed a single minor change on data retention clause — tracked in SOW_Redwood_v1.2.pdf

Ask: can BrightRetail provide a firm go/no-go on the commercial terms and confirm procurement timeline by COB Fri (2028-07-20)? If yes, we will:
1) Send DocuSign envelope with SOW + Order Form (sign order: BrightRetail technical lead -> BrightRetail CFO -> Redwood CFO)
2) Reserve the earliest Day 1 slot: target Aug 1 or, if you need more runway, Aug 14 as backup

I’ve attached the updated MAP and evidence artifacts for your procurement/legal review. If procurement needs a PO before DocuSign, flag that and we’ll coordinate.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/TP/Request/ABC-123-ESIGN
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/BR_MAP_v3

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad

mina.haddad@redwood.ai

Thanks Mina — this is helpful. Good to hear the engineering and SOC2 items are wrapped. Quick notes from my side:

- Legal has reviewed the SOW and the redline you mentioned is acceptable; small wording tweak on retention, no material change.
- Procurement expects to require a PO before countersignature; they asked whether the order form can be generated to attach to the PO. Procurement team is cc’d here.
- Timeline: procurement needs 3 business days to process a PO after we issue the order form. Given that, Aug 1 is tight but potentially doable if DocuSign + order form go out by EOD Thu (2028-07-19).

Plan proposed:
- We will aim to run the PO path in parallel to DocuSign. If procurement confirms PO, we’ll attach the PO when clearing CFO sign-off. If we can’t get a PO in time, we’ll push to Aug 14 start.

Please send the order form and DocuSign envelope tomorrow; I’ll chase procurement internally.

— Sophie
